name: desktop-library-light
prompt:
Generate one polished raster UI mockup for Wave Player. This is a second exploration following rejected generic, overpadded mocks. The design must recover the STRUCTURAL layout of a trading card: a compact portrait object with track identity at the top, dominant central artwork-like signal field, and carefully composed controls at the bottom. No fantasy/collectible decoration; no generic dashboard, loose card stack, padded toolbar, hardware chassis, gradients, bevels or marketing headline.

The actual historical player was 380 CSS px wide, 532 high (5:7), with 4px frame spacing and 8px inner insets. Honor that compact TALL silhouette, 1px square boundary, densely but thoughtfully composed anatomy. Do not turn it into a squarish media panel. Use 4-8px internal gaps and 8-12px insets. The visual field must occupy most of the card. Think precise independent music software informed by Stencil.so: finely ruled alignments, point/dither texture in graphics, compact mono annotations, almost no utility chrome.

THREE distinct typography roles, all important:
TX-02-like technical monospace for the strong loaded track title (approximately 25px, medium weight), times and small controls; it must visibly dominate identity, NOT a giant bold generic sans title.
Inter-like sans serif for artist/album and longer library text (12-14px).
Departure Mono-like crisp pixel monospace for short "VISUAL" / "LIBRARY" view labels and "A/B" markers (approximately 11px). Do not make all fonts the same, and do not invent telemetry labels to use the pixel font.

Loaded track is "Low Tide", "North Window", "Tidal Studies", playing at "01:24" of "04:32". Metadata is synthetic. Top identity has Low Tide, artist on next line with quieter album alongside. A tiny flat text navigation line below identity has "VISUAL" and "LIBRARY", with an understated underline on active view. These are integrated small text tabs, NOT boxed full-size buttons or a lone Library button in the corner.

Central signal field: illustrative phosphor-green oscilloscope, fine luminous repeating traces with restrained persistence against nearly black. Use the supplied phosphor image as signal character reference only. A little fine point texture within signal is welcome. No labels, HUD, axes, or frame ornaments on the art. Below the art, a SEPARATE full-track amplitude waveform with irregular transients and a precise solid playhead at 30.9%, consumed versus remaining amplitude in neutral ink shades. Elapsed 01:24 at left and 04:32 at right use small TX-02. Full-track waveform is for navigation, never confused with live scope.

Bottom controls: previous / PAUSE / next as a small centered group, finely drawn conventional skip icons, pause visibly emphasized but only a ~32px square, not a huge filled block. Clean space around the group. At the far left a very small "A/B" utility, off unless requested. At far right a small speaker/volume icon; volume slider is HIDDEN until opened, so NO horizontal slider crowds playback. Utility glyphs are subordinate, visible marks ~14-16px, with larger intended hit regions. No extra bottom utility band. Absolutely NO System/Light/Dark switch or theme button anywhere inside card. Theme selection lives in app Settings, not shown.

Reference component screenshots establish fine square neutral controls ONLY, do not copy their specimen padding, gallery layout or headers. Do not replicate old generated player images. No retrieved artwork, unknown metadata, brand hero, sidebar chrome or redundant playback labels. Image lettering can approximate real fonts but needs clear visual distinction.
Outside the player put a small board caption: "Design fixture — simulated waveform and playback".
LIGHT counterpart: board #f4f4f0, card #fffffc, text #171714, thin rules #d6d6ce. Keep the signal art near-black/green, but identity, waveform area and controls are deliberately light. Warm neutral remaining waveform, dark consumed waveform. No blue focus/gloss, neon control accents, drop shadow or grain on text.Library content, exactly five synthetic local files, rows separated by fine rules and tight 8px padding. Inter for track/artist text, TX-02 for durations and filename, Departure Mono pixel type for tiny short state labels. No artwork thumbnails, no pill badges. Header "SESSION" with understated "5 files", tiny "+ Add files" text action. Rows:
"Low Tide" / "North Window · Tidal Studies" / "04:32": small speaker symbol and unboxed "PLAYING" label, the loaded track.
"Glass Current" / "Static Bloom · Afterimage" / "06:18": separately selected using neutral tinted fill and a fine dotted focus outline, small unboxed "SELECTED" marker and "Load" text action. Browsing never replaces Low Tide automatically.
"A Map of the Room After Everyone Has Left" / "North Window · Tidal Studies — Late Sessions" / "08:47": allow natural two-line wrapping, keep duration aligned.
"field-recording_2026-08-19_take-07.wav" / "Metadata unavailable" / "—": honest filename fallback, wrap without omitting any portion.
"Night Transit" / "Static Bloom · Afterimage" / "—": warning icon, "Could not load" and small "Retry" action.
Compact footer "This session only". No search, filter chips, upload, database, playlists, or oversized add/close buttons.
Create ONE landscape desktop-library-light mockup at same 1440x1000 board proportions as first reference. First supplied image is the NEW compact-light anatomy control. Preserve its exact player pixel width and height, title, visual field, and bottom control composition. Move the player LEFT to make room for a tightly composed companion library to its RIGHT, separated by an 8px gap. Library is a distinct slim rectangular panel, same height as card, intended ~300px CSS wide versus card380px. It must not stretch the player, inflate the title or resemble a dashboard. Center combined composition on board, complete view visible. Keep compact player essentially identical to reference and its large green visual. Compact LIBRARY tab is now underlined to indicate companion open, while art stays visible.
Show A/B editing within existing small waveform/control area without increasing outer card height. A=00:48 at17.6% of waveform, B=01:36 at35.3%, acknowledged current playhead01:24 at30.9%, so A < playhead < B. A and B use thin square bracket endpoints and a subtle hatched span; current cursor stays a solid round-topped stem. Under waveform a single compact editing line "A 00:48   B 01:36   [checked] Loop   Reset", TX-02 values and Departure Mono A/B labels. Current01:24 and total04:32 stay visible. No seek-draft cursor in this still. Retain centered previous/Pause/next and subordinate volume icon at far right, hidden volume slider. Editing line may use a few pixels of visual height but card outer dimensions and width never change. No permanent theme controls. All library rows legible with emphasis on music, not specimen labels; state indicators unboxed. Keep fixture caption outside the combined composition.
